reference_target: presence of a documented ECG statement, not adjudicated clinical disease

RBBB.meaning: right bundle-branch block; code 105 incomplete excluded

PVC.meaning: presence in the record, not beat detection

PAC.meaning: atrial premature complexes as coded; code 31 excluded from primary endpoint

1AVB.meaning: prolonged PR; not adjudicated first-degree AV block

NSR.meaning: normal ECG; not a reference for normal sinus rhythm

ASMI.meaning: ECG anteroseptal MI statement; no assumption about acuity

IMI.meaning: ECG inferior MI statement; no assumption about acuity

LVH.meaning: ECG LVH statement; not imaging-confirmed hypertrophy

ISC_.meaning: ST or ST-T changes alone do not establish the target ischemia label

reference_negative_policy: not coded is a negative for the ECG-statement endpoint only where the publisher coding contract is accepted; no clinical-negative claim
